newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index falls 1.64 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index falls 1.64 pct.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index fell 1.42 points, or 1.64 percent, to 86.01 after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index shed 70.73 points, or 1.79 percent, to a provisional 3,870.26.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 14.26 percent from Wednesday's 14.78 percent.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
